verdict.rationale: Fellow is an AI meeting-notes SaaS with a built-in assistant (Ask Fellow), so acting as an MCP client is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence only shows Fellow running as an MCP server that external assistants like Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor connect to. Nothing shows Fellow itself connecting to third-party MCP servers or using their tools, and server-side MCP evidence cannot be credited to this client-side story.
